# Casa Bö

> Casa Bö is a luxury vacation villa with a private pool on Playa Langosta, Guanacaste, Costa Rica, four minutes from Tamarindo. Three bedrooms, sleeps up to 8, with Balinese furniture, an open-plan kitchen and a merged indoor/outdoor living space. Also listed on Airbnb and Vrbo.

## Pages
- [Home](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/): Overview, rating and reviews, who the villa suits
- [The Space](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/the-space.html): Pool, three bedrooms, kitchen, living room, amenities
- [Staff & Services](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/services.html): Included housekeeping and bookable extras (private chef, transfers, massage, yoga, scuba, tours)
- [Location](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/location.html): Distances to the beach, Tamarindo, Liberia (LIR) and San José (SJO) airports
- [Book Your Stay](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/book.html): Request dates directly or book on Airbnb or Vrbo

## Key facts
- Location: Playa Langosta, Tamarindo, Guanacaste, Costa Rica
- Sleeps: up to 8 guests, 3 bedrooms
- Check-in from 4:00 pm, check-out before 10:00 am
- Airports: Liberia (LIR) about 1.5 hours, San José (SJO) about 4.5 hours
- Languages on site: English, Spanish, French
